name: @payriff-sdk/node
description: Node.js client for the Payriff merchant API

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test "build/test/**/*.test.js"
